reviews.t: Dry Eye Mask by Heyedrate for Soothing Dry Eyes
reviews.x: Dry Eye Mask by Heyedrate works to provide soothing heat to eyes. The mask I received is not as large as shown in the picture. The mask's elastic band is less sturdy than a second similar product purchased for less price. The only plus for this eye mask (compress) is the little blue carrying bag that you get. I do not recommend this mask. Read others' reviews. Amazon provides lots of choices.  Best result for me is/was the Thermalon Dry Eye Moist Heat Compress on Amazon.

reviews.x: I bought this product for several reasons, but mostly to ease my dry, itchy eyes and subsequent burning eyes due to year round allergies.  I also read that it could possibly help dark undereye circles.   The mask works great for giving your eyes a break after a long day being around pollutants and allergens.  Or if I haven't had a good night's rest, this can really help.  My eyes feel less strained after using the mask.   I feel like my undereye and lids were a little less dark after using, howe

reviews.t: Great product to have so I bought two!
reviews.x: I bought two of the DRY EYE MASKs from Heyedrate. One is to heat everyday for my mdg and the other I keep it the freezer. They both work so well. Use the heated one every evening it my eyes and feels great. The cold one I use every morning,  My eyes are so puffy, swollen and hard to open. 20 minuets in the morning with the mask on my eyes is as energizing as my cup of coffee.

reviews.t: Great product! Very comfortable eye mask.
reviews.x: I love my new eye mask.  I have another brand eye mask which I do not use often.  This mask adjusts to a wide range of head sizes, and the mask covers a wider area of the eye.  It is very comfortable, and I may use it daily. It’s washable and comes in a nice blue pouch.

reviews.t: It is comfortable and fits well but it does not stay warm ...

When it is cool enough to tolerate, it then cools down so fast that you only can wear it for a few minintes. My doctor wanted me to wear it for 15 min. claims.text: Many reviewers say the mask effectively soothes dry, itchy, and tired eyes, with some reporting noticeable improvement after regular use.
Several reviewers complain that the mask does not stay warm long enough or fails to heat properly, even when following directions.
Reviewers frequently praise the mask's comfort and fit, noting it covers a wide area and adjusts to different head sizes.
Some reviewers report quality and durability problems, including a flimsy strap, a mask smaller than pictured, and hygiene concerns like hair strands on a seemingly returned item.
A few reviewers mention the white material gets dirty easily and question how to wash it since there is no detachable cover.

qa.q: Does it fit comfortably on all face sizes?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on fit across face sizes: some say it adjusts to a wide range of head sizes and fits well [2][3], while others say it could be smaller for thinner faces [1] and is too large, with beads slipping away from the eyes [6].

claims.text: The mask adjusts to a wide range of head sizes and fits well.
It could be a little smaller for thinner faces.
It is too large and the beads slip down away from the eyes.

qa.q: How long does the heat last per charge?
qa.answer: Reviews report the heat does not last long: one says it stays hot for no more than 2 minutes [2], another says it cools after about five minutes [6], and others say it cools within a few minutes [3] or even 5-10 seconds [4]. No review states a longer duration per charge.

claims.text: It stays hot for no more than 2 minutes.
It gets cool after about five minutes.
It cools so fast you can only wear it for a few minutes.
It becomes room temperature in 5-10 seconds.
